_thresholds_comment: break was null, so mutation measured and gated nothing. 78 is a floor with headroom: enough that ordinary refactoring does not trip it, little enough that losing a class of oracle does. It was set at 80.65% against a 75.5% baseline, when the degenerate-length survivors were killed. The v2 removal has since deleted envelope.ts, which was the weakest module at 77.84% and 80 of the 222 survivors — so the score should be HIGHER now, not lower, and this floor is if anything too generous. Raise it once a run on the v3-only set has produced a number.
